assumptions.scope: Offset includes common-mode/supply margin. TI lists typical bias/leakage, not guaranteed maxima; these allowances require prototype qualification.

power.note: Efficiency, wiring resistance and PCB drops are explicit planning allowances. Current sharing, inrush and both simultaneous faults need scope/thermal tests. Below 6V is brownout territory.

current_limiters.note: U9 limits the protected 12 V output after the boost reservoir. U4 and U9 latch on their specified faults. MCU enables allow deliberate CAN reset; no automatic retry.

capacitors.note: Manufacturer typical curve and independent engineering budgets, not a guaranteed minimum. Keep all three output capacitors pending measured loop/transient qualification.

stress.input_series_fault_tolerance: One series resistor; no longer survives that resistor shorting as a guaranteed fault case.
stress.scope: Unidirectional TVS provides negative surge clamping; not continuous negative signal operation, sustained overvoltage regulation or load-dump qualification.

status: Numerical assertions passed; physical qualification not performed.

regulated12.scope: Typical bias curves plus engineering allowances, not guaranteed capacitance. The boost reservoir is upstream of U9. Only C71 and external sensor capacitance can discharge directly into a port short. Test short insertion, hot-plug capacitance, SW overshoot and transient response.

rail_monitor.note: Rail ADCs qualify sensor power, not user analog inputs. Precision and transient excursions need measurement. Hardware UVLO, current limit and thermal latch remain independent of software. Startup grace 200ms; healthy 100ms; running low voltage 20ms; deliberate CAN restart only.

ADC_error_budget.scope: Engineering budget including divider drift, VREF calibration/drift, ADC reference/channel errors, input leakage and settling. Requires meter/temperature correlation; health flags are not precision voltage compliance.

rail_monitor.unpowered_scope: Stored sensor-rail charge can feed the MCU clamp through the 200kohm series ADC paths. Bound ignores diode drops and divider ground legs; no energized reverse-output support or unpowered functional guarantee.

passive_substitutions.scope: Engineering screening allowance, not a measured curve. Same nominal voltage, capacitance, dielectric and footprint; verify effective capacitance/ESR on prototype.

software_bias.limitations: Sensor residual LOW must be <=1.2 V at ~3.5 mA. Leakage budgets are compatibility limits, not measured guarantees. BAT46W 20uA reverse limit is specified at 60C/75V; 10k rail bleed is not galvanic isolation. Forward .55V and hot MOSFET 15ohm are engineering allowances requiring bench/temperature verification. Float mode for slow signals only; test actual cable capacitance and sensor leakage.

startup_and_default_off.scope: Steady resistor/leakage bounds and constant-current capacitor charging. Hot RDS(on)=15ohm and MCU/low-VGS gate leakage are engineering allowances; qualify over intended temperature. 470uF standalone SPICE is a typical diagnostic beyond the 100uF supported design envelope. No fast transient, single-fault or PCB thermal qualification.
